list_status: REPORTED, not confirmed: Rockstar and PlayStation had not published an official trophy list when this guide was built (20 Nov 2026). The 55 names, descriptions and grades below are the list reported in agreement by multiple outlets on 18 Nov 2026; the PSNProfiles community has called the circulating named list 'probably fake' and only the count of 55 traces to a dataminer claim. Verify every name and grade against your console's trophy list at launch. Sources are cited per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. It always comes last, so do not chase it directly: work the roadmap in order — story, the one missable, the nine one-shot moments, the stranger strands, then the open-world cleanup — and the platinum pops with the final trophy. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening story mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1. It is a story trophy, so it cannot be missed: finish the mission and it pops at the results screen. No preparation is needed — just follow the story in order. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock as the story advances, so this one pops when the chapter's final mission ends. Unmissable — the story carries you to it. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, it unlocks when the chapter closes — play the story straight through and it pops on its own. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. The chapter trophy pops at the end of the chapter's final mission. Keep playing the story in order and there is nothing to prepare or to miss. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks the same way as the others: complete the chapter's missions in order and it pops at the end. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final story mission to its end. It is the story's gold trophy and it pops when the credits roll. Stock up on ammo and armour before the mission starts, since the finale is usually the hardest fight in the game. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a mission trophy, so it pops when the mission ends — no side objective is needed. If you fail a checkpoint, just retry it; mission trophies only care that the mission is completed. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story heist The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are longer than normal ones, so take the setup steps seriously and keep a manual save from before the finale — the trophy only needs the heist finished, not a perfect run. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It pops at the mission's end like every other mission trophy. Nothing here is missable — the mission stays available until you finish it. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. As with the other mission trophies, failing and retrying a checkpoint costs nothing — only the completion counts. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Airport missions tend to be combat-heavy, so go in with full health and ammo. The trophy pops when the mission ends. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story mission trophy: finish the operation and it pops. No extra objective is required beyond completing the mission itself. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist: the full story, every stranger strand, the collectible sets, the activities and the stunt totals. Open the stats screen after the story and work down what is left — this is the last gold before the platinum, and it only unlocks once every checklist line is done. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts in total — jumps, near misses, long airtime and close calls all feed the same counter, and it is cumulative across the whole game. The fastest way is to chain jumps off highway ramps and hills on a fast bike; every stunt you land in free roam counts, so this one fills up on its own while you play. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample one of every activity type: a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, bowling, the shooting range, a drone race and any other activity the map offers. You only need to try each once — winning is not required. Tick them off one by one in an afternoon of free roam. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal on every Shooting Range challenge. Each lane has its own timing and target pattern, so run a lane once to learn it, then go for gold with the recommended weapon class. Medals are per challenge and retries are free, so grind one lane at a time until they are all gold. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations. Fly the course once slowly to learn the gates, then race it for real and cut the corners cleanly. Every location counts once, so work through the map location by location. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across the race types — street, off-road, boat and air races all count as long as each race is a different one. Repeating a win on the same race adds nothing, so keep moving to new races on the map. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and out-fish him. Match the lure to the water you are fishing, keep the line tension steady, and reel in when the fish runs toward you instead of fighting it. If Cal wins the round, challenge him again — the contest can be repeated. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any arcade cabinet to its end screen. Pick the shortest cabinet you can find, learn its one mechanic in a practice round, then play it through to completion. Any cabinet counts, so choose the easiest. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands unlock as you explore the map, so keep checking for Andy's marker between story missions and play each of his missions as it appears. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. His missions appear on the map as you progress, so follow his marker whenever it shows and play the strand to its end. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Billy's strand is bike-flavoured, so keep a fast bike handy for his missions and follow his marker whenever it appears on the map. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand is a chain of missions for one stranger — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest — and the trophy pops when the eighth chain is finished. Work one stranger at a time and keep an eye on the map for new markers. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. His missions revolve around supply runs, so keep a sturdy vehicle ready and follow his marker whenever it appears. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Play his missions as they appear on the map and the trophy pops at the end of his final mission. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. This is the guide's one missable trophy: spots tied to story areas can close off once you move on, so meditate at every spot you find as you explore and clear each region before leaving it. Use the checklist to tick spots off one by one — do not leave this for the endgame. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Track and hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Follow the trail clues to its territory, approach downwind and take the shot clean with a scoped rifle — a bad shot scares it off and you will have to pick up the trail again. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida in shops, hideouts and mission areas — pick up every card you pass, and trade duplicates to fill the gaps. Three finished sets is the goal, so focus on the sets closest to completion first. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations. Tag a spot, move on to the next, and keep a route through the map — the counter only counts distinct locations, so revisiting a tagged spot adds nothing. Work it into your exploration and it fills up steadily. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and activities, and the counter is cumulative across all types — so just play broadly and tick off the easy ones first. Check the challenge list in the pause menu to see what is left. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. Make a manual save before the attempt. Build the wanted level, then break line of sight — duck into alleys, switch vehicles and stay out of the search cones until the stars clear. If the attempt fails, reload the save and try again. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without the wanted level dropping in between. Make a manual save first. Plan a route with three close shops, hit them in quick succession and keep moving — if the wanted level clears between robberies the chain breaks, so do not stop. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle registers when you drive or ride a new model for the first time, so work through traffic, dealerships, parked cars and mission vehicles. Rare models hide in specific districts, so vary where you drive. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Make a manual save first. Lure a group together before you activate focus, then chain the kills while it lasts — spread-out enemies waste the window. If you fall short, reload and set the group up again. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: make an unscheduled departure from VCIA airport. Make a manual save first, then leave the airport by an unplanned route — the trophy pops on the escape itself, not on reaching a destination, so commit to the exit once you start. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Take on the Rhino tank sequence — steal or survive a Rhino encounter. Use cover, keep moving so the cannon cannot track you, and hit it with heavy weapons when it exposes itself. The trophy pops when the tank sequence is done. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: rob a jewelry store without being detected. Make a manual save first. Move quietly, avoid the cameras and the guards' sightlines, take the goods and leave unseen — one detection ruins the attempt, so reload the save and try a different route in. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT per vault: rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Make a manual save before every vault. Plan the exit before you go in, grab the cash fast and break away cleanly — each vault counts only if you escape, so a sloppy getaway wastes the run. Five clean vaults and the silver pops. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: rob an armored truck and escape. Make a manual save first. Stop the truck, get the crew out of the way, grab the cash and break away before backup arrives — speed matters more than firepower here, so have a fast getaway vehicle waiting. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit every region of Leonida. Drive the map edge to edge — cities, swamps, beaches and backroads — and the trophy pops when the last region registers. Pair it with the collectible hunts so the driving does double duty. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in the state. Each gang's operation counts once, so find each gang's turf, hit its operation and move to the next gang. The map's gang territories tell you where to look. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This is a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge: go to the Ocean Beach spot, order the drink and let the scene play. No skill or preparation is needed. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Make a manual save first, get into a vehicle inside the showroom, then drive straight out through the front — the trophy pops on the escape. Commit to the exit; hesitating in the doorway wastes the run. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Finish a full game and follow through on every frame — the trophy is about completing the game, not about your score, so take your time with the aim. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Complete the partnership moment the description hints at. This is a story-side scene trophy: it pops when the partnership scene plays out, so keep playing the story and the side strands and it will come to you. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make the story choice the description points to. The trophy pops when the choice scene resolves — there is no way to miss it once you reach that moment in the story, so just keep playing. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail the moment once, then get it on the second try. This trophy is built for the retry: if your first attempt does not land, the second attempt is the one that counts, so do not reload — just try again. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Trigger the strange encounter the description hints at. Explore the odd corners of Leonida — the out-of-the-way places, the late-night spots — and the moment pops when you find it. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: ONE-SHOT: bowl the pins over with a melee drive-by. Make a manual save first, line the pins up from your vehicle, and drive through with a melee weapon out. Aim for the middle of the set — a glancing pass knocks down too few. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. Run bills through your contacts over time — the total is cumulative, so keep laundering whenever you have marked bills on hand and the counter climbs toward $250,000. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops of all kinds. Buy cars, clothes, weapons and food — the total adds up across every shop, so normal spending counts. If you are short at the end, a car purchase closes the gap fast. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on the market. Save up through the story and side work, then buy each garage as it appears for sale — the trophy pops when the last garage is yours. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find a vehicle, open the app and register it — ten different vehicles count, so grab a mix of cars and bikes as you find them around the city. Sources: Output Lag, KeenGamer.
